name: Getting started
content:
## Smart Fishing Monitor

This dashboard brings together forecast conditions for **Sassoon Dock, Mumbai** and telemetry from the local MQTT sensor simulator. The live summary values and status indicators will be connected in the next implementation step.

name: Weather data
content:
## Weather forecast

This view is for current air temperature, wind speed, and the five-day rainfall forecast from the Open-Meteo Forecast API at the configured location. Live values will be connected in Phase 4.3.

name: Marine and sensor data
content:
## Water conditions

This view brings together marine forecast conditions and simulated MQTT sensor telemetry, including water temperature, water level, catch count, and device battery. Live values will be connected in Phase 4.3.
